title: Primordial Black Hole Formation in $f(R)=R+αR^2$ Gravity: Perturbative and Non-Perturbative Analysis
summary: We present a complete analytic and semi-analytic study of gravitational collapse and primordial black hole (PBH) formation in the quadratic $f(R)$ model $f(R)=R+αR^2$. We first derive the perturbative expansion around General Relativity (GR), working to first order in the small parameter $α$. For a collapsing flat FLRW dust interior we compute the explicit first-order corrections to the scale factor, the stellar radius, and the horizon formation time. { We then use these results to infer the expected trend in the PBH formation threshold $δ_c$, rather than a direct quantitative determination.…
